import.continue.heading: The import is paused
import.continue.master_help: Asked for again, because the server only opens an import window for a freshly confirmed password.
import.continue.text: The server closed the import window before everything was sent. {queued} item(s) are still waiting on this device. Nothing is lost.
import.continue.window_note: A window closes when its time or its room has run out, or when the server starts again. Confirm your master password to get a new one: only the items that are left are sent, and the ones the server already has are not stored twice.
import.done.failed: {count} item(s) were refused by the server. They stay on this device as changes that were not sent; open the list to see them.
import.done.heading: The import has finished
import.done.next: The imported items are in your list. Ferret does not remove duplicates, so look through the list and delete what you do not need.
import.error.import_archive_too_large: The archive is larger than the import allows (2 GiB). Export as CSV instead, which has no attachments.
import.error.import_archive_too_many: The archive holds more files than the import allows. Export as CSV instead, which has no attachments.
import.error.import_bad_answer: The import worker gave an answer that Ferret does not accept. Nothing was imported. Reload the page and try again.
import.error.import_bad_csv: The file is not a valid CSV file.
import.error.import_bad_export: This is not an export file of Ferret's, or it is damaged or made with settings Ferret does not accept.
import.error.import_bad_format: Ferret does not read this kind of file. Choose a .ferretexport, .json, .csv or .avux file.
import.error.import_bad_json: The file is not valid JSON.
import.error.import_bad_key: The file holds a key that an export never has, so it is refused.
import.error.import_bad_zip: The ZIP file is damaged or not one that Ferret reads.
import.error.import_does_not_fit: The file holds more items than your vault has room for. Nothing was imported.
import.error.import_empty: The file holds no items that can be imported.
import.error.import_encrypted_export: This export is encrypted. Ferret cannot read it. Export the vault again without encryption: from Bitwarden as a .json or .csv file, from AliasVault as an .avux or CSV file.
import.error.import_export_password_requ: Type the export password of the file.
import.error.import_export_too_large: The file is larger than any Ferret export can be.
import.error.import_field_too_large: A value in the file is longer than the import allows (64 KiB).
import.error.import_manifest_too_large: The list of items in the archive (manifest.json) is larger than the import allows (50 MiB).
import.error.import_nothing_left: There is nothing left to send.
import.error.import_port_closed: The vault was locked or closed before the import finished. Nothing was imported.
import.error.import_preview_gone: The file was let go of. Choose it again.
import.error.import_seal_failed: The vault refused to store an item, so the import stopped. Nothing was imported.
import.error.import_timeout: The import took too long and was stopped. Nothing was imported. Try again, or split the file.
import.error.import_too_deep: The file is nested too deeply to be an export of a vault.
import.error.import_too_large: The file is larger than the import allows (50 MiB).
import.error.import_too_many: The file holds more items than the import allows (10 000).
import.error.import_unreadable: The file could not be read.
import.error.import_window_open: Another device has an import open for this vault. It keeps other devices from importing for up to 30 minutes, also when that device has been signed out or has stopped. To clear it, finish the import on that device (or start a new import there after signing in), or wait until the 30 minutes are over.
import.error.import_worker_failed: The part of the page that reads the file failed. Nothing was imported. Reload the page and try again.
import.error.import_wrong_export_passwor: The export password is wrong, or the file has been changed. Nothing was imported.
import.error.import_zip: This is a ZIP file. Ferret cannot read ZIP exports. Export the vault again as an unencrypted .json or .csv file without attachments.
import.error.import_zip_encrypted: The ZIP file is encrypted. Ferret cannot read it.
import.error.import_zip_entry_missing: The ZIP file lacks the file that the export is read from.
import.error.locked: The vault was locked. Nothing was imported.
import.error.quota_exceeded: The vault has no room for this many items. Nothing was imported.
import.error.quota_exceeded_continue: The vault has no room for the items that are left. The ones that were already sent are kept. Make room, then continue.
import.error.unsupported: The part of the page that reads the file could not take this request.
import.file.help: Choose a .ferretexport, .json, .csv or .avux file. It is read on this device and is not uploaded.
import.file.label: File to import
import.form.export_password_help: The password you chose when you made the export file. Making the key from it takes some seconds and a lot of memory on purpose.
import.form.master_help: Asked for again, because an import writes to your vault and the server wants a freshly confirmed password for it.
import.form.secret_key_help: This device does not remember the secret key. Type it from page 1 of your emergency sheet.
import.formats.aliasvault: An AliasVault export without encryption, as .avux or CSV. In AliasVault, export the vault and pick the unencrypted .avux file (or CSV), not the encrypted .avex file.
import.formats.bitwarden: A Bitwarden export without encryption, as .json or .csv. In Bitwarden, choose Export vault and pick .json or .csv.
import.formats.ferret: A Ferret export (.ferretexport), made on the Export page. It opens with the export password you chose then.
import.formats.not: Not read: Bitwarden's encrypted .json, AliasVault's encrypted .avex, and the .zip export with attachments. Passkeys, folders, collections, tags and attachments in a file are left out.
import.heading: Import
import.intro: Bring items into your vault from a file. The file is read on this device, and every item is encrypted in your vault before anything goes to the server.
import.label.title: Title
import.note.http: {count} address(es) start with http://. Ferret does not fill them on pages that use https. Change them to https:// if the site supports it.
import.note.matchNull: {count} address(es) had no matching rule in the file. Ferret matches only the exact host, which can be narrower than the other service did, so the item may not be offered on other subdomains of the site.
import.note.textAddresses: {count} address(es) are not web addresses (an app address, for example). They are kept as text on the item and are never used to fill a page.
import.plain.after: Delete the file you imported from, for good, and empty the trash or recycle bin. It holds every one of these passwords in plain text. If it was in a synced folder or a backup, delete it there too.
import.plain.before: This file is not encrypted. Import it, then delete it for good: do not leave it in your downloads folder, a synced folder or the trash.
import.plain.note: A file from Bitwarden or AliasVault is not encrypted: it holds every password in plain text, and anyone who gets it can read all of them. When the import has finished, delete the file for good and empty the trash or recycle bin. Your computer may also keep copies in a synced folder, a backup or a download history.
import.preview.export_count_later: How many items it holds is known once the export password has opened it. If they do not all fit in your vault, nothing is imported.
import.preview.heading: What the file holds
import.preview.no_room: Your vault has no room for more items. Nothing can be imported.
import.preview.not_empty: Your vault already holds {count} item(s). The import adds the new items next to them. Ferret does not look for duplicates, so an item that is already in your vault will be there twice.
import.preview.room: Your vault has {used} item(s) and room for {free} more.
import.preview.too_many: This file holds {count} items, but your vault has room for {free}. Nothing can be imported. Delete items you do not need, or import fewer.
import.progress.queueing: Storing {items} item(s) on this device before they are sent...
import.progress.stretching: Making the key from the export password. This takes some seconds and uses a lot of memory.
import.progress.window: Asking the server for room to import {items} item(s)...
import.sending.heading: Sending the items
import.sending.keep_open: The items are stored on this device. If you close this page, the sending goes on the next time Ferret is open, and nothing is sent twice.
import.sending.text: {sent} of {total} item(s) are on the server; {queued} are still waiting.
import.skipped.attachments: Attachments are not imported: {count} attachment(s) in the file were left out.
import.skipped.collections: Collections are not imported: {count} collection(s) in the file were left out.
import.skipped.fieldHistory: The earlier values of {count} field(s) are not imported.
import.skipped.folders: Folders are not imported: {count} folder(s) in the file were left out.
import.skipped.linked: {count} linked custom field(s) were left out. A linked field points to another field and holds no value of its own.
import.skipped.otherTypes: {count} item(s) of a kind Ferret does not store (SSH keys, bank accounts, driver's licences, passports or something newer) were left out.
import.skipped.passkeys: {count} passkey(s) were left out. Passkeys cannot be imported, but the rest of the item was.
import.skipped.passwordHistory: The password history of {count} item(s) is not imported.
import.skipped.reprompt: {count} item(s) asked for the master password before they are shown. That setting is not imported.
import.skipped.tags: Tags are not imported: {count} tag(s) in the file were left out.
import.skipped.tooLarge: {count} item(s) were too large to store and were left out.
import.skipped.trashed: {count} item(s) that were in the trash of the other service were left out.
import.skipped.unknownKeys: {count} entry(ies) of the file that Ferret does not know were left out.
import.title: Import
import.warning.alias_needs_aliasvault: {count} item(s) have an e-mail address that may be an alias made by AliasVault. It is kept as a field, but such an address only receives mail while your AliasVault server runs.
import.warning.card_and_login: {count} row(s) held both card details and login details. They are imported as one login that has the card fields in it.
import.warning.dropped: {count} more notes about single items are not listed.
import.warning.field_type_unknown: {count} custom field(s) were of a kind Ferret does not know. They are kept as hidden fields.
import.warning.field_unreadable: {count} custom field(s) could not be read and were left out.
import.warning.item_archived: {count} item(s) were archived in AliasVault. They are imported as ordinary items.
import.warning.match_never: {count} address(es) were set never to fill. They are kept as text on the item and not as an address.
import.warning.match_regex: {count} address(es) used a regular expression. It is kept as text on the item, because Ferret never matches on a pattern.
import.warning.match_starts_with: {count} address(es) matched on how they start. Ferret matches the whole address instead, which is narrower.
import.warning.match_unknown: {count} address(es) had a match rule that Ferret does not know. They match the whole address.
import.warning.totp_extra: {count} item(s) had more than one one-time password. Ferret keeps one per item, so the others are kept as hidden fields.
import.warning.totp_invalid: {count} one-time password secret(s) could not be read. They are kept as a hidden field, and no code is made from them.
import.warning.totp_steam: {count} Steam Guard secret(s) are kept as a hidden field. Ferret does not make Steam Guard codes.
import.warning.uri_https_added: {count} address(es) had no http:// or https:// and got https:// in front.
